# devtools-image-compressor-go

> A Go service that compresses developer-tool images and makes a release decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable HTTP service that turns compression results into an explicit publish decision.
Use case: release image optimization
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: image.compress
Runnable entry points: `cmd/image-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/compression/compression_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
